#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
srgn - a code surgeon

A grep-like tool which understands source code syntax and allows for manipulation
in addition to search.
"""

import argparse
import re
import sys
import os
import glob as glob_module
from typing import List, Optional, Tuple, Dict, Any
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum

VERSION = "0.14.1"

class Action(Enum):
    REPLACE = "replace"
    DELETE = "delete"
    SQUEEZE = "squeeze"
    UPPER = "upper"
    LOWER = "lower"
    TITLECASE = "titlecase"
    NORMALIZE = "normalize"
    GERMAN = "german"
    SYMBOLS = "symbols"

@dataclass
class Args:
    scope: Optional[str]
    replacement: Optional[str]
    upper: bool
    lower: bool
    titlecase: bool
    normalize: bool
    german: bool
    symbols: bool
    delete: bool
    squeeze: bool
    literal_string: bool
    glob: Optional[str]
    fail_no_files: bool
    dry_run: bool
    invert: bool
    fail_any: bool
    fail_none: bool
    only_matching: bool
    line_numbers: bool
    count: bool
    files_with_matches: bool
    files: bool
    inplace: bool
    completions: Optional[str]
    python: bool
    rust: bool
    go: bool
    typescript: bool
    csharp: bool
    c: bool
    hcl: bool
    c_query: Optional[str]
    c_query_file: Optional[str]
    rust_query: Optional[str]
    rust_query_file: Optional[str]
    typescript_query: Optional[str]
    typescript_query_file: Optional[str]
    german_prefer_original: bool
    german_naive: bool

def parse_args(args: List[str]) -> Args:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="srgn",
        description="A grep-like tool which understands source code syntax and allows for manipulation in addition to search",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
    )
    
    parser.add_argument("scope", nargs="?", default=".*",
                        help="Scope to apply to, as a regular expression pattern.")
    parser.add_argument("replacement", nargs="?", default=None,
                        help="Replace anything in scope with this value.")
    
    # Composable Actions
    parser.add_argument("-u", "--upper", dest="upper", action="store_true",
                        help="Uppercase anything in scope.")
    parser.add_argument("-l", "--lower", dest="lower", action="store_true",
                        help="Lowercase anything in scope.")
    parser.add_argument("-t", "--titlecase", dest="titlecase", action="store_true",
                        help="Titlecase anything in scope.")
    parser.add_argument("-n", "--normalize", dest="normalize", action="store_true",
                        help="Normalize (Normalization Form D) anything in scope, and throw away marks.")
    parser.add_argument("-g", "--german", dest="german", action="store_true",
                        help="Perform substitutions on German words.")
    parser.add_argument("-S", "--symbols", dest="symbols", action="store_true",
                        help="Perform substitutions on symbols.")
    
    # Standalone Actions
    parser.add_argument("-d", "--delete", dest="delete", action="store_true",
                        help="Delete anything in scope.")
    parser.add_argument("-s", "--squeeze", dest="squeeze", action="store_true",
                        help="Squeeze consecutive occurrences of scope into one.")
    
    # Options
    parser.add_argument("-L", "--literal-string", dest="literal_string", action="store_true",
                        help="Do not interpret the scope as a regex. Instead, interpret it as a literal string.")
    parser.add_argument("-G", "--glob", dest="glob",
                        help="Glob of files to work on (instead of reading stdin).")
    parser.add_argument("--fail-no-files", dest="fail_no_files", action="store_true",
                        help="Fail if working on files but none are found.")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", dest="dry_run", action="store_true",
                        help="Do not destructively overwrite files, instead print rich diff only.")
    parser.add_argument("-i", "--invert", dest="invert", action="store_true",
                        help="Undo the effects of passed actions, where applicable.")
    parser.add_argument("--fail-any", dest="fail_any", action="store_true",
                        help="Fail if any match is found.")
    parser.add_argument("--fail-none", dest="fail_none", action="store_true",
                        help="Fail if no match is found.")
    parser.add_argument("--only-matching", dest="only_matching", action="store_true",
                        help="Print only matched portions.")
    parser.add_argument("--line-numbers", dest="line_numbers", action="store_true",
                        help="Include line numbers.")
    parser.add_argument("-c", "--count", dest="count", action="store_true",
                        help="Print only the count of matches.")
    parser.add_argument("--files-with-matches", dest="files_with_matches", action="store_true",
                        help="Print only the names of files with matches.")
    parser.add_argument("--files", dest="files", action="store_true",
                        help="Print only the names of files processed.")
    parser.add_argument("--inplace", dest="inplace", action="store_true",
                        help="Modify files in place.")
    parser.add_argument("--completions", dest="completions", metavar="COMPLETIONS",
                        help="Print shell completions for the given shell.")
    parser.add_argument("--python", dest="python", action="store_true",
                        help="Use Python syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--rust", dest="rust", action="store_true",
                        help="Use Rust syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--go", dest="go", action="store_true",
                        help="Use Go syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--typescript", dest="typescript", action="store_true",
                        help="Use TypeScript syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--csharp", dest="csharp", action="store_true",
                        help="Use C# syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--c", dest="c", action="store_true",
                        help="Use C syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--hcl", dest="hcl", action="store_true",
                        help="Use HCL syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--c-query", dest="c_query", metavar="C_QUERY",
                        help="Use the given C query.")
    parser.add_argument("--c-query-file", dest="c_query_file", metavar="C_QUERY_FILE",
                        help="Use the given C query file.")
    parser.add_argument("--rust-query", dest="rust_query", metavar="RUST_QUERY",
                        help="Use the given Rust query.")
    parser.add_argument("--rust-query-file", dest="rust_query_file", metavar="RUST_QUERY_FILE",
                        help="Use the given Rust query file.")
    parser.add_argument("--typescript-query", dest="typescript_query", metavar="TYPESCRIPT_QUERY",
                        help="Use the given TypeScript query.")
    parser.add_argument("--typescript-query-file", dest="typescript_query_file", metavar="TYPESCRIPT_QUERY_FILE",
                        help="Use the given TypeScript query file.")
    parser.add_argument("--german-prefer-original", dest="german_prefer_original", action="store_true",
                        help="Prefer original characters in German transformation.")
    parser.add_argument("--german-naive", dest="german_naive", action="store_true",
                        help="Use naive German transformation.")
    
    parsed = parser.parse_args(args)
    
    # Handle -- separator for replacement argument
    if parsed.replacement is None and len(args) > 0:
        # Check if there's a -- separator
        for i, arg in enumerate(args):
            if arg == '--' and i < len(args) - 1:
                parsed.replacement = args[i + 1]
                break
    
    return parsed

def escape_regex(s: str) -> str:
    """Escape special regex characters."""
    return re.escape(s)

    """Transform German words."""
    result = s
    substitutions = [("ae", "ä"), ("oe", "ö"), ("ue", "ü"), ("ss", "ß")]

def process_input(input_str: str, regex: re.Pattern, args: Args) -> str:
    """Process input with all specified actions."""
    result = input_str
    
    # Apply replacement first if specified
    if args.replacement is not None:
        result = regex.sub(args.replacement, result)
    
    # Apply other actions
    if args.upper:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).upper(), result)
    if args.lower:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).lower(), result)
    if args.titlecase:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).capitalize(), result)
    if args.normalize:
        import unicodedata
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: "".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", m.group(0)) if not unicodedata.category(c).startswith("M")), result)
    if args.german:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: german_transform(m.group(0), args.german_prefer_original, args.german_naive), result)
    if args.symbols:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: symbols_transform(m.group(0)), result)
    if args.delete:
        result = regex.sub("", result)
    if args.squeeze:
        result = ""
        last_end = 0
        for mat in regex.finditer(result):
            result += result[last_end:mat.start()]
            result += "X"
            last_end = mat.end()
        result += result[last_end:]
        result = result.replace("XX", "X").replace("X", "")
    
    return result

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
srgn - a code surgeon

A grep-like tool which understands source code syntax and allows for manipulation
in addition to search.
"""

import argparse
import re
import sys
import os
import glob as glob_module
from typing import List, Optional, Tuple, Dict, Any
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum

VERSION = "0.14.1"

class Action(Enum):
    REPLACE = "replace"
    DELETE = "delete"
    SQUEEZE = "squeeze"
    UPPER = "upper"
    LOWER = "lower"
    TITLECASE = "titlecase"
    NORMALIZE = "normalize"
    GERMAN = "german"
    SYMBOLS = "symbols"

@dataclass
class Args:
    scope: Optional[str]
    replacement: Optional[str]
    upper: bool
    lower: bool
    titlecase: bool
    normalize: bool
    german: bool
    symbols: bool
    delete: bool
    squeeze: bool
    literal_string: bool
    glob: Optional[str]
    fail_no_files: bool
    dry_run: bool
    invert: bool
    fail_any: bool
    fail_none: bool
    only_matching: bool
    line_numbers: bool
    count: bool
    files_with_matches: bool
    files: bool
    inplace: bool
    completions: Optional[str]
    python: bool
    rust: bool
    go: bool
    typescript: bool
    csharp: bool
    c: bool
    hcl: bool
    c_query: Optional[str]
    c_query_file: Optional[str]
    rust_query: Optional[str]
    rust_query_file: Optional[str]
    typescript_query: Optional[str]
    typescript_query_file: Optional[str]
    german_prefer_original: bool
    german_naive: bool

def parse_args(args: List[str]) -> Args:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="srgn",
        description="A grep-like tool which understands source code syntax and allows for manipulation in addition to search",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
    )
    
    parser.add_argument("scope", nargs="?", default=".*",
                        help="Scope to apply to, as a regular expression pattern.")
    parser.add_argument("replacement", nargs="?", default=None,
                        help="Replace anything in scope with this value.")
    
    # Composable Actions
    parser.add_argument("-u", "--upper", dest="upper", action="store_true",
                        help="Uppercase anything in scope.")
    parser.add_argument("-l", "--lower", dest="lower", action="store_true",
                        help="Lowercase anything in scope.")
    parser.add_argument("-t", "--titlecase", dest="titlecase", action="store_true",
                        help="Titlecase anything in scope.")
    parser.add_argument("-n", "--normalize", dest="normalize", action="store_true",
                        help="Normalize (Normalization Form D) anything in scope, and throw away marks.")
    parser.add_argument("-g", "--german", dest="german", action="store_true",
                        help="Perform substitutions on German words.")
    parser.add_argument("-S", "--symbols", dest="symbols", action="store_true",
                        help="Perform substitutions on symbols.")
    
    # Standalone Actions
    parser.add_argument("-d", "--delete", dest="delete", action="store_true",
                        help="Delete anything in scope.")
    parser.add_argument("-s", "--squeeze", dest="squeeze", action="store_true",
                        help="Squeeze consecutive occurrences of scope into one.")
    
    # Options
    parser.add_argument("-L", "--literal-string", dest="literal_string", action="store_true",
                        help="Do not interpret the scope as a regex. Instead, interpret it as a literal string.")
    parser.add_argument("-G", "--glob", dest="glob",
                        help="Glob of files to work on (instead of reading stdin).")
    parser.add_argument("--fail-no-files", dest="fail_no_files", action="store_true",
                        help="Fail if working on files but none are found.")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", dest="dry_run", action="store_true",
                        help="Do not destructively overwrite files, instead print rich diff only.")
    parser.add_argument("-i", "--invert", dest="invert", action="store_true",
                        help="Undo the effects of passed actions, where applicable.")
    parser.add_argument("--fail-any", dest="fail_any", action="store_true",
                        help="Fail if any match is found.")
    parser.add_argument("--fail-none", dest="fail_none", action="store_true",
                        help="Fail if no match is found.")
    parser.add_argument("--only-matching", dest="only_matching", action="store_true",
                        help="Print only matched portions.")
    parser.add_argument("--line-numbers", dest="line_numbers", action="store_true",
                        help="Include line numbers.")
    parser.add_argument("-c", "--count", dest="count", action="store_true",
                        help="Print only the count of matches.")
    parser.add_argument("--files-with-matches", dest="files_with_matches", action="store_true",
                        help="Print only the names of files with matches.")
    parser.add_argument("--files", dest="files", action="store_true",
                        help="Print only the names of files processed.")
    parser.add_argument("--inplace", dest="inplace", action="store_true",
                        help="Modify files in place.")
    parser.add_argument("--completions", dest="completions", metavar="COMPLETIONS",
                        help="Print shell completions for the given shell.")
    parser.add_argument("--python", dest="python", action="store_true",
                        help="Use Python syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--rust", dest="rust", action="store_true",
                        help="Use Rust syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--go", dest="go", action="store_true",
                        help="Use Go syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--typescript", dest="typescript", action="store_true",
                        help="Use TypeScript syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--csharp", dest="csharp", action="store_true",
                        help="Use C# syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--c", dest="c", action="store_true",
                        help="Use C syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--hcl", dest="hcl", action="store_true",
                        help="Use HCL syntax highlighting.")
    parser.add_argument("--c-query", dest="c_query", metavar="C_QUERY",
                        help="Use the given C query.")
    parser.add_argument("--c-query-file", dest="c_query_file", metavar="C_QUERY_FILE",
                        help="Use the given C query file.")
    parser.add_argument("--rust-query", dest="rust_query", metavar="RUST_QUERY",
                        help="Use the given Rust query.")
    parser.add_argument("--rust-query-file", dest="rust_query_file", metavar="RUST_QUERY_FILE",
                        help="Use the given Rust query file.")
    parser.add_argument("--typescript-query", dest="typescript_query", metavar="TYPESCRIPT_QUERY",
                        help="Use the given TypeScript query.")
    parser.add_argument("--typescript-query-file", dest="typescript_query_file", metavar="TYPESCRIPT_QUERY_FILE",
                        help="Use the given TypeScript query file.")
    parser.add_argument("--german-prefer-original", dest="german_prefer_original", action="store_true",
                        help="Prefer original characters in German transformation.")
    parser.add_argument("--german-naive", dest="german_naive", action="store_true",
                        help="Use naive German transformation.")
    
    parsed = parser.parse_args(args)
    
    # Handle -- separator for replacement argument
    if parsed.replacement is None and len(args) > 0:
        # Check if there's a -- separator
        for i, arg in enumerate(args):
            if arg == '--' and i < len(args) - 1:
                parsed.replacement = args[i + 1]
                break
    
    return parsed

def escape_regex(s: str) -> str:
    """Escape special regex characters."""
    return re.escape(s)

def german_transform(s: str, prefer_original: bool, naive: bool) -> str:
    """Transform German words."""
    result = s
    substitutions = [("ae", "ä"), ("oe", "ö"), ("ue", "ü"), ("ss", "ß")]
    for ascii, unicode_char in substitutions:
        if naive:
            result = result.replace(ascii, unicode_char)
        else:
            result = result.replace(ascii, unicode_char)
    return result

def process_input(input_str: str, regex: re.Pattern, args: Args) -> str:
    """Process input with all specified actions."""
    result = input_str
    
    # Apply replacement first if specified
    if args.replacement is not None:
        result = regex.sub(args.replacement, result)
    
    # Apply other actions
    if args.upper:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).upper(), result)
    if args.lower:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).lower(), result)
    if args.titlecase:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).capitalize(), result)
    if args.normalize:
        import unicodedata
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: "".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", m.group(0)) if not unicodedata.category(c).startswith("M")), result)
    if args.german:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: german_transform(m.group(0), args.german_prefer_original, args.german_naive), result)
    if args.symbols:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: symbols_transform(m.group(0)), result)
    if args.delete:
        result = regex.sub("", result)
    if args.squeeze:
        result = ""
        last_end = 0
        for mat in regex.finditer(result):
            result += result[last_end:mat.start()]
            result += "X"
            last_end = mat.end()
        result += result[last_end:]
        result = result.replace("XX", "X").replace("X", "")
    
    return result

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
srgn - a code surgeon

A grep-like tool which understands source code syntax and allows for manipulation
in addition to search.
"""

import argparse
import re
import sys
import os
import glob as glob_module
from typing import List, Optional, Tuple, Dict, Any
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum

VERSION = "0.14.1"

class Action(Enum):
    REPLACE = "replace"
    DELETE = "delete"
    SQUEEZE = "squeeze"
    UPPER = "upper"
    LOWER = "lower"
    TITLECASE = "titlecase"
    NORMALIZE = "normalize"
    GERMAN = "german"
    SYMBOLS = "symbols"

@dataclass
class Args:
    scope: Optional[str]
    replacement: Optional[str]
    upper: bool
    lower: bool
    titlecase: bool
    normalize: bool
    german: bool
    symbols: bool
    delete: bool
    squeeze: bool
    literal_string: bool
    glob: Optional[str]
    fail_no_files: bool
    dry_run: bool
    invert: bool
    fail_any: bool
    fail_none: bool
    only_matching: bool
    line_numbers: bool
    count: bool
    files_with_matches: bool
    files: bool
    inplace: bool
    completions: Optional[str]
    python: bool
    rust: bool
    go: bool
    typescript: bool
    csharp: bool
    c: bool
    hcl: bool
    c_query: Optional[str]
    c_query_file: Optional[str]
    rust_query: Optional[str]
    rust_query_file: Optional[str]
    typescript_query: Optional[str]
    typescript_query_file: Optional[str]
    german_prefer_original: bool
    german_naive: bool

def parse_args(args: List[str]) -> Args:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="srgn",
        description="A grep-like tool which understands source code syntax and allows for manipulation in addition to search",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
    )
    
    parser.add_argument("scope", nargs="?", default=".*",
                        help="Scope to apply to, as a regular expression pattern.")
    parser.add_argument("replacement", nargs="?", default=None,
                        help="Replace anything in scope with this value.")
    
    # Composable Actions
    parser.add_argument("-u", "--upper", dest="upper", action="store_true",
                        help="Uppercase anything in scope.")
    parser.add_argument("-l", "--lower", dest="lower", action="store_true",
                        help="Lowercase anything in scope.")
    parser.add_argument("-t", "--titlecase", dest="titlecase", action="store_true",
                        help="Titlecase anything in scope.")
    parser.add_argument("-n", "--normalize", dest="normalize", action="store_true",
                        help="Normalize (Normalization Form D) anything in scope, and throw away marks.")
    parser.add_argument("-g", "--german", dest="german", action="store_true",
                        help="Perform substitutions on German words.")
    parser.add_argument("-S", "--symbols", dest="symbols", action="store_true",
                        help="Perform substitutions on symbols.")
    
    # Standalone Actions
    parser.add_argument("-d", "--delete", dest="delete", action="store_true",
                        help="Delete anything in scope.")
    parser.add_argument("-s", "--squeeze", dest="squeeze", action="store_true",
                        help="Squeeze consecutive occurrences of scope into one.")
    
    # Options
    parser.add_argument("-L", "--literal-string", dest="literal_string", action="store_true",
                        help="Do not interpret the scope as a regex. Instead, interpret it as a literal string.")
    parser.add_argument("-G", "--glob", dest="glob",
                        help="Glob of files to work on (instead of reading stdin).")
    parser.add_argument("--fail-no-files", dest="fail_no_files", action="store_true",
                        help="Fail if working on files but none are found.")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", dest="dry_run", action="store_true",
                        help="Do not destructively overwrite files, instead print rich diff only.")
    parser.add_argument("-i", "--invert", dest="invert", action="store_true",
                        help="Undo the effects of passed actions, where applicable.")
    parser.add_argument("--fail-any", dest="fail_any", action="store_true",
                        help="Fail if any match is found.")
    parser.add_argument("--fail-none", dest="fail_none", action="store_true",
                        help="Fail if no match is found.")
    parser.add_argument("--only-matching", dest="only_matching", action="store_true",
                        help="Print only matched portions.")
    parser.add_argument("--line-numbers", dest="line_numbers", action="store_true",
                        help="Include line numbers.")
    parser.add_argument("-c", "--count", dest="count", action="store_true",
                        help="Print only the count of matches.")
    parser.add_argument("--files-with-matches", dest="files_with_matches", action="store_true",
                        help="Print only the names of files with matches.")
    parser.add_argument("--files", dest="files", action="store_true",
                        help="Print only the names of files processed.")
    parser.add_argument("--inplace", dest="inplace", action="store_true",
                        help="Modify files in place.")

def escape_regex(s: str) -> str:
    """Escape special regex characters."""
    return re.escape(s)

def german_transform(s: str, prefer_original: bool, naive: bool) -> str:
    """Transform German words."""
    result = s
    substitutions = [("ae", "ä"), ("oe", "ö"), ("ue", "ü"), ("ss", "ß")]
    for ascii, unicode_char in substitutions:
        if naive:
            result = result.replace(ascii, unicode_char)
        else:
            result = result.replace(ascii, unicode_char)
    return result

def process_input(input_str: str, regex: re.Pattern, args: Args) -> str:
    """Process input with all specified actions."""
    result = input_str
    
    # Apply replacement first if specified
    if args.replacement is not None:
        result = regex.sub(args.replacement, result)
    
    # Apply other actions
    if args.upper:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).upper(), result)
    if args.lower:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).lower(), result)
    if args.titlecase:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).capitalize(), result)
    if args.normalize:
        import unicodedata
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: "".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", m.group(0)) if not unicodedata.category(c).startswith("M")), result)
    if args.german:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: german_transform(m.group(0), args.german_prefer_original, args.german_naive), result)
    if args.symbols:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: symbols_transform(m.group(0)), result)
    if args.delete:
        result = regex.sub("", result)
    if args.squeeze:
        result = ""
        last_end = 0
        for mat in regex.finditer(result):
            result += result[last_end:mat.start()]
            result += "X"
            last_end = mat.end()
        result += result[last_end:]
        result = result.replace("XX", "X").replace("X", "")
    
    return result

def german_transform(s: str, prefer_original: bool, naive: bool) -> str:
    """Transform German words."""
    result = s
    substitutions = [("ae", "ä"), ("oe", "ö"), ("ue", "ü"), ("ss", "ß")]
    for ascii, unicode_char in substitutions:
        if naive:
            result = result.replace(ascii, unicode_char)
        else:
            result = result.replace(ascii, unicode_char)
    return result

def symbols_transform(s: str) -> str:
    """Transform symbols."""
    result = s
    substitutions = [
        ("!", "≠"),
        ("->", "→"),
        ("==", "≡"),
        ("<=", "≤"),
        (">=", "≥"),
        ("+-", "±"),
    ]
    for ascii, unicode_char in substitutions:
        result = result.replace(ascii, unicode_char)
    return result

def process_input(input_str: str, regex: re.Pattern, args) -> str:
    """Process input with all specified actions."""
    result = input_str
    
    if args.replacement is not None:
        result = regex.sub(args.replacement, result)
    
    if args.upper:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).upper(), result)
    if args.lower:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).lower(), result)
    if args.titlecase:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).capitalize(), result)
    if args.normalize:
        import unicodedata
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: "".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", m.group(0)) if not unicodedata.category(c).startswith("M")), result)
    if args.german:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: german_transform(m.group(0), args.german_prefer_original, args.german_naive), result)
    if args.symbols:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: symbols_transform(m.group(0)), result)
    if args.delete:
        result = regex.sub("", result)
    if args.squeeze:
        result = ""
        last_end = 0
        for mat in regex.finditer(result):
            result += result[last_end:mat.start()]
            result += "X"
            last_end = mat.end()
        result += result[last_end:]
        result = result.replace("XX", "X").replace("X", "")
    
    return result
'''

def process_input(input_str: str, regex: re.Pattern, args) -> str:
    """Process input with all specified actions."""
    result = input_str
    
    if args.replacement is not None:
        result = regex.sub(args.replacement, result)
    
    if args.upper:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).upper(), result)
    if args.lower:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).lower(), result)
    if args.titlecase:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).capitalize(), result)
    if args.normalize:
        import unicodedata
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: "".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", m.group(0)) if not unicodedata.category(c).startswith("M")), result)
    if args.german:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: german_transform(m.group(0), args.german_prefer_original, args.german_naive), result)
    if args.symbols:
        result = regex.sub(lambda m: symbols_transform(m.group(0)), result)
    if args.delete:
        result = regex.sub("", result)
    if args.squeeze:
        matches = list(regex.finditer(result))
        if not matches:
            return result
        merged = []
        for mat in matches:
            if merged and merged[-1][1] == mat.start():
                merged[-1] = (merged[-1][0], mat.end())
            else:
                merged.append((mat.start(), mat.end()))
        result_parts = []
        last_end = 0
        for start, end in merged:
            result_parts.append(result[last_end:start])
            result_parts.append(regex.pattern)
            last_end = end
        result_parts.append(result[last_end:])
        return "".join(result_parts)
    
    return result

+    #[arg(short = 't', long = "titlecase", env = "TITLECASE")]
+    titlecase: bool,
+
+    /// Normalize (Normalization Form D) anything in scope, and throw away marks.
+    #[arg(short = 'n', long = "normalize", env = "NORMALIZE")]
+    normalize: bool,
+
+    /// Perform substitutions on German words, such as 'Abenteuergruesse' to 'Abenteuergrüße', for anything in scope.
+    #[arg(short = 'g', long = "german", env = "GERMAN")]
+    german: bool,
+
+    /// Perform substitutions on symbols, such as '!=' to '≠', '-→' to '→', on anything in scope.
+    #[arg(short = 'S', long = "symbols", env = "SYMBOLS")]
+    symbols: bool,
+
+    /// Replace anything in scope with this value.
+    #[arg(value_name = "REPLACEMENT", env = "REPLACE")]
+    replacement: Option<String>,
+
+    /// Delete anything in scope.
+    #[arg(short = 'd', long = "delete")]
+    delete: bool,
+
+    /// Squeeze consecutive occurrences of scope into one.
+    #[arg(short = 's', long = "squeeze", env = "SQUEEZE", alias = "squeeze-repeats")]
+    squeeze: bool,
+
+    /// Glob of files to work on (instead of reading stdin).
+    #[arg(short = 'G', long = "glob")]
+    glob: Option<String>,
+
+    /// Fail if working on files (e.g. globbing is requested) but none are found.
+    #[arg(long = "fail-no-files")]
+    fail_no_files: bool,
+
+    /// Do not destructively overwrite files, instead print rich diff only.
+    #[arg(long = "dry-run")]
+    dry_run: bool,
+
+    /// Undo the effects of passed actions, where applicable.
+    #[arg(short = 'i', long = "invert", env = "INVERT")]
+    invert: bool,
+

+    #[arg(short = 'L', long = "literal-string", env = "LITERAL_STRING")]
+    literal_string: bool,
+
+    /// Python language scope.
+    #[arg(long = "python", env = "PYTHON")]
+    python: Option<String>,
+
+    /// Rust language scope.
+    #[arg(long = "rust", env = "RUST")]
+    rust: Option<String>,
+
+    /// Go language scope.
+    #[arg(long = "go", env = "GO")]
+    go: Option<String>,
+
+    /// TypeScript language scope.

+
+    /// C language scope.
+    #[arg(long = "c", env = "C")]

+    csharp: Option<String>,
+
+    /// HCL language scope.
+    #[arg(long = "hcl", env = "HCL")]
+    hcl: Option<String>,
+

+    /// Print only the count of matches.

+    count: bool,

+    #[arg(long = "fail-any")]

+    files_with_matches: bool,
+
+    /// Sorted output ordering.
+    #[arg(long = "sorted")]
+    sorted: bool,
+}
+
+fn main() {
+    let args = Args::parse();
+    
+    if let Some(shell) = args.completions {
+        print_completions(shell);
+        return;
+    }
+
+    let input = read_input(&args);
+    let result = process_input(&input, &args);
+    
+    if let Err(e) = result {
+        eprintln!("Error: {}", e);
+        process::exit(1);
+    }
+}
+
+fn read_input(args: &Args) -> String {
+    if let Some(glob_pattern) = &args.glob {
+        let files = glob::glob(glob_pattern)
+            .unwrap()
+            .filter_map(|p| p.ok())
+            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
+        
+        if args.files {
+            for f in &files {
+                println!("{}", f.display());
+            }
+            return String::new();
+        }
+        
+        if files.is_empty() && args.fail_no_files {
+            process::exit(1);
+        }
+        
+        let mut combined = String::new();
+        for f in &files {
+            if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(f) {
+                combined.push_str(&content);
+                combined.push('\n');
+            }
+        }
+        return combined;
+    }
+    
+    let mut input = String::new();
+    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();
+    input
+}
+
+fn process_input(input: &str, args: &Args) -> Result<String, String> {
+    let scope = &args.scope;
+    let is_literal = args.literal_string;
+    
+    // Build regex
+    let regex = if is_literal {
+        Regex::new(&regex::escape(scope.as_ref().unwrap())).unwrap()
+    } else {
+        Regex::new(scope.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap()
+    };
+    
+    // Apply replacement first if specified
+    let mut result = if let Some(repl) = &args.replacement {
+        regex.replace_all(input, repl.as_str())
+    } else {
+        input.to_string()
+    };
+    
+    // Apply other actions
+    if args.upper {
+        result = result.to_uppercase();
+    }
+    if args.lower {
+        result = result.to_lowercase();
+    }
+    if args.titlecase {
+        result = titlecase(&result);
+    }
+    if args.normalize {
+        result = normalize(&result);
+    }
+    if args.german {
+        result = german(&result);
+    }
+    if args.symbols {
+        result = symbols(&result);
+    }
+    if args.delete {
+        result = delete(&result, &regex);
+    }
+    if args.squeeze {
+        result = squeeze(&result, &regex);
+    }
+    
+    Ok(result)
+}
+
+fn titlecase(s: &str) -> String {
+    s.split_whitespace()
+        .map(|word| {
+            let mut chars = word.chars();
+            match chars.next() {
+                None => String::new(),
+                Some(c) => c.to_uppercase().collect::<String>() + chars.as_str(),
+            }
+        })
+        .collect()
+}
+
+fn normalize(s: &str) -> String {
+    use unicode_normalization::UnicodeNormalization;
+    s.nfd()
+        .filter(|c| !c.is_mark())
+        .collect()
+}
+
+fn german(s: &str) -> String {
+    s.replace("ae", "ä")
+     .replace("oe", "ö")
+     .replace("ue", "ü")
+     .replace("ss", "ß")
+}
+
+fn symbols(s: &str) -> String {
+    s.replace("!", "¡")
+     .replace("?", "¿")
+     .replace("=", "⎔")
+     .replace("+", "⊞")
+     .replace("-", "−")
+     .replace("*", "⋆")
+     .replace("/", "⌟")
+     .replace("(", "⎔")
+     .replace(")", "⎕")
+     .replace("[", "⎔")
+     .replace("]", "⎕")
+     .replace("{", "⎔")
+     .replace("}", "⎕")
+     .replace("<", "⋖")
+     .replace(">", "⋗")
+     .replace("=", "⎔")
+     .replace("!", "¡")
+     .replace("?", "¿")
+}
+
+fn delete(s: &str, regex: &Regex) -> String {
+    regex.split(s).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("")
+}
+
+fn squeeze(s: &str, regex: &Regex) -> String {
+    regex.split(s)
+        .map(|part| {
+            regex.find_iter(part)
+                .map(|m| m.as_str())
+                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+                .join("")
+        })
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join("")
+}
+
+fn print_completions(shell: String) {
+    println!("Completions for {}", shell);
+}

+            elif arg in ("-n", "--normalize"):

+            elif arg in ("-g", "--german"):

+            elif arg in ("-d", "--delete"):

+def german_transform(s: str) -> str:
+    """Transform German words."""
+    result = s
+    substitutions = [("ae", "ä"), ("oe", "ö"), ("ue", "ü"), ("ss", "ß")]
+    for ascii, unicode_char in substitutions:
+        result = result.replace(ascii, unicode_char)
+    return result
+
+def symbols_transform(s: str) -> str:
+    """Transform symbols."""
+    result = s
+    substitutions = [
+        ("!", "≠"),
+        ("->", "→"),
+        ("==", "≡"),
+        ("±", "±"),
+        ("≥", "≥"),
+        ("≤", "≤"),
+        ("+-", "±"),
+        ("!", "¡"),
+        ("?", "¿"),
+        ("=", "≔"),
+        ("+", "∓"),
+        ("-", "−"),
+        ("*", "∙"),
+        ("/", "∸"),
+        ("(", "≔"),
+        (")", "≕"),
+        ("[", "≔"),
+        ("]", "≕"),
+        ("{", "≔"),
+        ("}", "≕"),
+        ("<", "⋞"),
+        (">", "⋟"),
+    ]
+    for ascii, unicode_char in substitutions:
+        result = result.replace(ascii, unicode_char)
+    return result
+
+def process_input(input_str: str, regex: re.Pattern, args) -> str:
+    """Process input with all specified actions."""
+    result = input_str
+    
+    if args.replacement is not None:

+    
+    if args.upper:
+        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).upper(), result)
+    if args.lower:
+        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).lower(), result)
+    if args.titlecase:
+        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0).title(), result)
+    if args.normalize:
+        import unicodedata
+        result = regex.sub(lambda m: ''.join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize('NFD', m.group(0)) if not unicodedata.combining(c)), result)
+    if args.german:
+        result = regex.sub(lambda m: german_transform(m.group(0)), result)
+    if args.symbols:
+        result = regex.sub(lambda m: symbols_transform(m.group(0)), result)
+    
+    if args.delete:
+        result = regex.sub("", result)
+    if args.squeeze:
+        result = regex.sub(lambda m: m.group(0), result)
+    
+    return result
+
+def read_input(args) -> str:
+    """Read input from stdin or glob."""
+    if args.glob:
+        files = glob_module.glob(args.glob)
+        if args.files:
+            for f in files:
+                print(f)
+            return ""
+        
+        if not files and args.fail_no_files:
+            sys.exit(1)
+        
+        combined = ""
+        for f in files:
+            try:
+                with open(f, 'r') as file:
+                    content = file.read()
+                    combined += content + "\n"
+            except Exception as e:
+                print(f"Error reading {f}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return combined
+    
+    input_str = sys.stdin.read()
+    return input_str
+
+def main():
+    args = parse_args(sys.argv[1:])
+    
+    if args.version:
+        print(VERSION)
+        return
+    
+    if args.completions:
+        print(f"Completions for {args.completions}")
+        return
+    
+    input_str = read_input(args)
+    
+    # Build regex
+    is_literal = args.literal_string
+    scope = args.scope
+    if is_literal:
+        regex = re.compile(re.escape(scope))
+    else:
+        regex = re.compile(scope)
+    
+    result = process_input(input_str, regex, args)
+    
+    if args.exit_code_only:
+        print("0")
+        return
+    
+    print(result, end='')
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
